title: A Lightning Weapon
description: Introducing a new type of sword. The one and only, Electro Sword! Use it as destruction for builds, or just combat fun in general, it just takes one right click
body:
# A Lightning Weapon
## Introducing the Electro Sword!

That's right! Using one right click with this sword, the Electro Sword, you can electrify anything in front of you, using lightning. For any weapon or item in Minecraft, it often needs a recipe. So.. we added a recipe to it:

![Updated Electro Sword recipe. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e40676458857d79931cb00af2681bb634c64b19.png)

## What's new in the 1.1 update? 

**Electro Powered Blade:** This is the most deadly weapon in this mod (for now), it might even be deadly for you the player. With one right click, thunder and lightning strikes you and any mob around you, and leaves a big hole where it happened. 
NOTE: Use it wisely.. and use Regeneration effect lvl 255, Resistance and Fire resistance 255, and all effects infinite seconds/minutes. 

**Electro Pickaxe:** Right click to place.. uh dripstone, so you can set up traps for your enemies (or friends..). And the efficiency of this pickaxe is unreal, use it on stone on anything that is broken with a pickaxe, and see what happens, evena Netherite Block didn't stand a chance. 

Other stuff: A new **electro ingot**, a **new electro ore**, **fuel bucket** (to power the blade, i mean to craft it but in a fancy way), and **Activated Fuel Bucket**, used for getting spilled on the ground like water and lava buckets, doesn't really do anything else. All can be found in the video above.
